title: 2026 AMC 8 Problem 3
statement:
Haruki has a piece of wire that is \(24\) centimeters long. He wants to bend it to form each of the following shapes, one at a time.

A regular hexagon with side length \(5\) cm.

A square of area \(36\) cm².

A right triangle whose legs are \(6\) and \(8\) cm long.

Which of the shapes can Haruki make?

solutions.text: The regular hexagon would have perimeter \(6\cdot5=30\), too long for the wire. The square has side length \(6\), so its perimeter is \(24\). The right triangle has hypotenuse \(10\), so its perimeter is \(6+8+10=24\). Haruki can make the square and the triangle only.
